title: The first picture of a black hole
alt: A blurry ring of orange and yellow light, brighter along the bottom, around a dark centre, on a black background: the black hole in the galaxy Messier 87.
author: Event Horizon Telescope, uploader cropped and converted TIF to JPG

description: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) — a planet-scale array of eight ground-based radio telescopes forged through international collaboration — was designed to capture images of a black hole.
